resources.string: Nothing on this phone can open that
Is everything Walk Buddy needs working on this phone?
All good. Nothing needs your attention.
Works, with a few tips below.
Not allowed, so steps cannot be counted.
Built-in step counter found. It keeps counting while the app is closed.
Only a simpler sensor was found. Steps are counted only while Walk Buddy is running and may be approximate.
No step sensor was found on this phone.
Only approximate location is allowed. Walks work, but the map is rougher.
Not allowed. Walks with a buddy need location to show distance.
Location is switched off in the phone settings.
Notifications are off. Walk and reminder notices will not appear.
Unrestricted. Step counting is least likely to be stopped.
Optimised. Some phones stop background step counting; allow unrestricted if steps go missing.
The server answered. Walking with a buddy or a group should connect.
The server did not answer. It may be waking up (up to a minute) or you may be offline. Solo walking and steps never need it.
Low on space or not writable. Walk history and photos may fail to save.
Diagnostics is a short text log kept on this phone. Codes, links, places and names are removed. It is only shared if you tap Export and pick an app.
Walk Buddy does not check for updates by itself. This button opens the releases page in your browser.
The app makes no network request when you tap this; your browser does.
No accounts, no analytics, no ads, no trackers. Your steps and walks stay on this phone. Location is shared only with the buddy or group you walk with, only during a walk.
All walkers, scenery and icons are original artwork made for this app.
Check that permissions, sensors and the server work, or export a short diagnostics file to share when asking for help.
Choose the picture behind the walkers on the Track.
Seasonal follows the month. Scenery is still artwork, so it stays calm with Reduce motion or Battery saver.
Changes the app language. Your phone\'s own language setting is not changed.
A gentle nudge at the times you pick. You can snooze it, say you cannot today, or skip it.
Say it is a walk together
When you have a walking partner, the reminder uses their name.
Notifications are off, so reminders cannot show. Allow them to get your reminders.
Reminders use one flexible background job and no alarms, so Android may show one a few minutes late. Nothing leaves your phone.
Even ten minutes counts. Go at your own pace.
A short walk together counts. Ready when you are.
